rawFindings.title: Exported declarations are double-counted as multiple statements
rawFindings.explanation: Removing export declarations from the parent skip list makes the rule count both the ExportNamedDeclaration/ExportDefaultDeclaration and its child declaration on the same line. A single exported variable or function declaration is therefore treated as two statements.
rawFindings.suggestion: Add `Export(?:Default|Named)Declaration` back to `SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED`, or otherwise skip counting the child declaration when its parent is an export declaration.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: With rule option `{max: 1}` and parser options `{ecmaVersion: 6, sourceType: "module"}`, linting `export let foo = 0;` reports “This line has too many statements” even though there is only one exported declaration on the line.
